metadata.question: Was there snow present in the Atacama Desert during the months of June and July in 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use daily snow cover from VIIRS VNP10A1 (NOAA/VIIRS/002/VNP10A1) for 2025-06-01 to 2025-07-31 over a polygon approximating the Atacama Desert (-30 to -18 lat, -72 to -66 lon). If empty, fall back to MODIS MOD10A1 (MODIS/061/MOD10A1).
2. Masking strategy: Use the NDSI_Snow_Cover band, keeping only valid values (0–100). Determine snow presence where max NDSI_Snow_Cover > 10% during the period.
3. Valid Zero vs Null: If collections exist but valid pixel count after masking is 0 -> C2. If reduceRegion returns null/NaN or fraction outside [0,100] -> C3. Otherwise, if snow pixel count ≥ 5, answer Yes; else No.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[-72.0, -30.0], [-72.0, -18.0], [-66.0, -18.0], [-66.0, -30.0], [-72.0, -30.0]]
    ]);
    const start = '2025-06-01';
    const end = '2025-07-31';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    const candidates = [
      {id: 'NOAA/VIIRS/002/VNP10A1', band: 'NDSI_Snow_Cover'},
      {id: 'MODIS/061/MOD10A1', band: 'NDSI_Snow_Cover'}
    ];

    let used = null;
    let col = null;
    let primarySize = 0;

    // Try primary
    let tempCol = ee.ImageCollection(candidates[0].id).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
    primarySize = await tempCol.size().getInfo();
    if (primarySize > 0) {
      used = candidates[0];
      col = tempCol;
    } else {
      // Fallback
      tempCol = ee.ImageCollection(candidates[1].id).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      const fbSize = await tempCol.size().getInfo();
      if (fbSize > 0) {
        used = candidates[1];
        col = tempCol;
      } else {
        console.log('Primary images: 0; Fallback images: 0');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).'); // repeat to ensure final line tag, but we will finalize below
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    const nImages = await col.size().getInfo();

    // 3. Processing
    const band = used.band;
    const colMasked = col.map(function(img) {
      const snow = img.select(band);
      const valid = snow.gte(0).and(snow.lte(100));
      return snow.updateMask(valid).rename(band);
    });

    // Mosaic max NDSI_Snow_Cover during the period
    const maxSnow = colMasked.max();

    // Counts
    const scale = 1000;
    const totalCountDict = await ee.Image(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();
    const totalCount = totalCountDict ? totalCountDict['ones'] : null;

    const validCountDict = await maxSnow.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();
    const validCount = validCountDict ? validCountDict[band] : null;

    if (validCount === null || totalCount === null) {
      console.log(`Collection Used: ${used.id}`);
      console.log(`Images: ${nImages} (${start} to ${end})`);
      console.log('Calculation failure: null counts.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Collection Used: ${used.id}`);
      console.log(`Images: ${nImages} (${start} to ${end})`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const snowMask = maxSnow.gt(10).rename('snow'); // presence threshold >10%
    const snowCountDict = await snowMask.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();
    const snowCount = snowCountDict ? snowCountDict['snow'] : null;

    if (snowCount === null) {
      console.log(`Collection Used: ${used.id}`);
      console.log(`Images: ${nImages} (${start} to ${end})`);
      console.log('Calculation failure: snow count is null.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const invalidPct = totalCount > 0 ? (100 * (1 - validCount / totalCount)) : null;
    const snowFrac = (snowCount / validCount) * 100;

    if (!(snowFrac >= 0 && snowFrac <= 100)) {
      console.log(`Collection Used: ${used.id}`);
      console.log(`Images: ${nImages} (${start} to ${end})`);
      console.log('Calculation failure: fraction out of bounds.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Collection Used: ${used.id}`);
    console.log(`Images: ${nImages} (${start} to ${end})`);
    console.log(`Total Pixels (1km): ${totalCount}`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`Invalid/Masked (%): ${invalidPct !== null ? invalidPct.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Snow Pixels (>10%): ${snowCount}`);
    console.log(`Snow Fraction (% of valid): ${snowFrac.toFixed(3)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    // Require at least 5 pixels to avoid single-pixel noise over this large ROI.
    if (snowCount >= 5) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
